title: PRE-REGISTRATION -- Attack B: train the cheap leg (generator LoRA on Lingshu-7B).
written_before: ANY adapted-arm number existed. At the time of writing, on disk there are: the image-disjoint train split, the trained adapter ckpts/train/lora_cheapleg_s0, the merged checkpoint, and the FULLY COMPLETE frozen-7B control arm (MedEvalKit 5 cells + 3 open cells + judge + frozen-verifier scores). The adapted arm's open-text generation was launched at 01:09 and had produced only ckpt_slake_open_adapt7b_s0.jsonl (the greedy slake_open file). NO adapted-arm accuracy, oracle@8, sel_eff, p10 or macro number had been computed or observed by the author of this file.
author_note: This file exists so that the decision rule cannot be chosen after seeing the result. It supersedes nothing; two other pre-registrations from this round (armcombine, pathvqa_confirm) are untouched.
hypothesis: Every ceiling measured in this project (p10, oracle@8, greedy, sel_eff) is a property of a FROZEN Lingshu-7B. The verifier has been trained ~20 ways and all converge at sel_eff 0.80-0.81; the GENERATOR has never been trained. Training the generator should move greedy, oracle@8 and p10 simultaneously -- i.e. move the frontier rather than harvest inside it.

arms.base: frozen Lingshu-7B, snapshot b98aecd4..., served by vLLM tp=1
arms.adapted: ckpts/train/merged_cheapleg_s0 = the same snapshot with lora_cheapleg_s0 merged into full weights, served by vLLM tp=1
arms.matched_control_requirement: BOTH arms are generated by the SAME scripts (runners/run_cheapleg_open_gen.sh, runners/run_cheapleg_mcq.sh) in the SAME serving configuration, differing ONLY in --model_path. This is mandatory: the round-1 standing caveat is that regenerating an open-text arm under a different configuration reproduces published cells only to ~+-0.008. Already CONFIRMED on the control arm before this file was written -- the regenerated frozen-7B control differs from the published frozen-7B numbers by up to -0.0145 on oracle@8 (0.611514 vs 0.626013) and -0.0048..+0.0040 on the MCQ cells. No adapted-arm number will EVER be compared against a stored published number; only against this matched control.

endpoints.primary: MACRO accuracy over the 8 Variant-B reporting cells (1/8 each) of the published accuracy-max (certified veto) cascade, run end-to-end with the ADAPTED cheap leg, versus always-32B-direct. Paired item-level bootstrap, nboot=10000, seed 20260811. WIN = CI excludes zero on the positive side.
endpoints.frontier_secondary: Per cell, adapted-minus-base deltas in: greedy accuracy; oracle@8 (open cells); sel_eff under the FROZEN incumbent verifier ckpts/train/lora_verifier_disjoint; selected accuracy; p10 = P(7B right AND 32B-direct wrong).
endpoints.identity: selected = oracle@8 x sel_eff, exactly. The additive form greedy + sel_eff*(oracle-greedy) over-predicts by +0.09..+0.11 and will not be used.

decision_rule.SUCCESS: macro delta vs always-32B-direct with 95% CI excluding zero AND guardrail-clean (no cell significantly worse).
decision_rule.PARTIAL_SUCCESS: a significant rise in oracle@8 or p10 on at least one cell even if macro does not move, because those are the ceilings every other method works inside.
decision_rule.KILL: no significant movement in greedy or oracle@8 on any cell.
decision_rule.guardrail: report every cell; a cell is flagged if the adapted arm is significantly worse. vqa_rad_open/closed are n=200/251 and their clean-seed counts have historically run 0/10 to 7/10, so a flag there is reported WITH the note that it may be within seed noise.

seed_limitation_declared_in_advance.rule4: The standing methodology requires >=10 seeds where training is involved, and states 'a single seed is not a result' (a prior round's 'win' was the top of its own 10-seed range).
seed_limitation_declared_in_advance.why_one: One LoRA training run took 122.9 min on this box; 10 seeds is ~20 GPU-hours plus 10x the generation/judge/scoring chain. Not feasible in this session.
seed_limitation_declared_in_advance.consequence_accepted_in_advance: ANY macro win from this single seed is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a headline, and must be labelled so. It would require seed replication before it could be claimed. A NEGATIVE or a KILL is much more robust to this limitation than a win would be, and a large consistent frontier movement across 8 cells is more informative than a small macro delta.

confounds_to_report_whether_or_not_they_.answer_letter_prior: PMC-VQA v2 gold letters are strongly skewed and train_2.csv carries the SAME skew: test_2 A .1323 B .3585 C .3780 D .1312 (n=33430); train_2 A .1378 B .3561 C .3780 D .1281 (n=152603). B+C = 73.65% test / 73.41% train; the constant-'C' floor is 0.3780 in BOTH. A model fine-tuned on train_2 can therefore gain PMC-VQA accuracy by learning the LABEL PRIOR rather than the medicine. This will be reported for both arms as: predicted-letter histogram, accuracy stratified by GOLD letter, and BALANCED accuracy (unweighted mean over the four gold letters). A prior-only gain shows up as the predicted histogram moving toward the gold histogram, per-gold-letter accuracy rising on B/C and FALLING on A/D, and balanced accuracy moving less than raw accuracy -- or not at all.
confounds_to_report_whether_or_not_they_.train_eval_resolution_mismatch: Recorded in ckpts/train/lora_cheapleg_s0/train_config.json: medeval-frame training images were capped at 1,003,520 px while MedEvalKit evaluates at a 12,845,056 px cap. The open-text frame is matched (cap320 both sides). This mismatch can only HURT the adapted arm on the 5 MCQ cells and is a live alternative explanation for any MCQ loss.
confounds_to_report_whether_or_not_they_.one_nan_training_step: logs/train_cheapleg_s0.log prints loss(last200)=nan at step 5600/5667 (the only nan in the file; the rolling window means one poisoned step suffices). The saved adapter was independently verified BEFORE any evaluation: 584 tensors, 47,589,376 params, 0 NaN, 0 Inf, max|w| 0.042553, no all-zero tensors. Reported as a caveat, not hidden.
confounds_to_report_whether_or_not_they_.adapter_reaches_visual_mlp_not_visual_at: The LoRA target list (q,k,v,o,gate,up,down _proj) matches the visual tower's MLP (64 gate/up/down x 32 blocks = 192 tensors) but NOT its fused attention `qkv`/`proj`. Merge verified at tensor level: visual.blocks.{0,15,31}.mlp.* max|delta| 1.8e-3..2.8e-3 CHANGED, visual.blocks.0.attn.{qkv,proj} exactly 0.0 (never targeted). So the probe line '0.0 on visual attn.qkv' in the merge report is EXPECTED, not a failed merge.

null_tests_required_and_their_status_at_.merge_and_serving: PENDING re-run. Arms A (HF base+adapter) and B (HF merged) ran; arm C (vLLM merged) failed to start because vLLM V1 spawns its EngineCore and cheapleg_merge_validate.py has no __main__ guard. Re-queued with VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0, which moves the engine in-process and changes nothing about the model, checkpoint, prompts or sampling. Standing rule 10 (never score a visual LoRA under vLLM) is structurally discharged by MERGING -- vLLM loads a merged checkpoint through the ordinary full-weights path, so the adapter-dropping bug cannot apply -- but the empirical A/B/C demonstration is still owed.

the_one_unavoidable_patch: paper_baselines.build_cells carries four asserts that the F1 slice router still picks the PUBLISHED per-benchmark policy. Those are drift guards for the published 7B. On a DIFFERENT 7B the router is SUPPOSED to re-pick -- if the adapted 7B beat the 32B on a cell, the router choosing always_7b there would BE the result. cheapleg_macro.py loads paper_baselines from source with exactly those four asserts replaced by a recorder, asserts that exactly four substitutions were made, and reports every router choice. Verified by the macro null test above to reproduce the published numbers exactly on the base arm.
framing_disclosure_owed_in_the_writeup: If this works it changes the method's framing from 'test-time compute only' to 'train the cheap leg + test-time compute'. The project is already not purely training-free: the deployed open-text verifier (lora_verifier_disjoint) is a trained LoRA. This will be stated plainly and not editorialised beyond a sentence or two.
